name: Shopify Admin API
description: Shopify Admin GraphQL requests for products, orders, customers, inventory and analytics using fixed query and mutation documents.

auth_methods.description: Supply the Admin API access token, store domain and optional API version.

store_domain.description: The store myshopify.com domain used in the Admin GraphQL endpoint.

api_version.description: Defaults to the official 2026-07 stable Admin API version.

setup.label: Shopify Admin API access token
setup.description: Supply an existing Shopify Admin API access token and the store myshopify.com domain. The token requires the scopes for the selected requests; acquire it outside this library.

fields.description: The store myshopify.com domain used in the Admin GraphQL endpoint.
fields.label: Store domain

fields.description: Defaults to the official 2026-07 stable Admin API version.
fields.label: Admin API version

actions.description: Conversion funnel metrics: sessions, orders, customers, and ShopifyQL conversion_rate (values in shop currency)
Customer cohort analysis showing customers, orders, and sales grouped by time period

sort_by.description: Sort by total spend or order count

actions.description: Customer lifetime value report from the ShopifyQL customers dataset showing customer_name, total_amount_spent, and total_orders. Note: groups by customer_name, which may not be unique across customers with the same name.
Analyze discount impact on sales: discounted vs total revenue, discount percentage, and total discount amount

group_by.description: Group orders by day, week, or month

actions.description: Order count and metrics grouped by day/week/month (values in shop currency)

sort_by.description: Sort vendors by: revenue or orders

actions.description: Revenue and orders broken down by product vendor

Sales reversal summary for a date range using documented Shopify sales metrics (orders, sales_reversals, gross_sales, net_sales, discounts; values in shop currency). Does not compute a physical-return rate.
Approximate repeat customer rate for a date range. Uses ShopifyQL customers vs orders count to estimate repeat purchasing behavior.
Revenue and orders broken down by sales channel

group_by.description: Group sales by country or region

actions.description: Sales breakdown by geographic region (country or region) using ShopifyQL

compare_to.description: Compare against the previous period of equal length, or the same period last year

end_date.description: ISO 8601 date for the end of the period, e.g. 2026-01-31

group_by.description: Time granularity for the comparison breakdown

start_date.description: ISO 8601 date for the start of the period, e.g. 2026-01-01

actions.description: Compare sales metrics across time periods using ShopifyQL COMPARE TO. Returns current and comparison period data with percent changes - ideal for period-over-period analysis.
Sales total/average by date range (values in shop currency)

sort_by.description: Sort by revenue or order count

actions.description: Best-selling products by revenue or order count in a date range (values in shop currency)
Session traffic analytics over time, grouped by day, week, or month
Add one or more tags to a customer using the tagsAdd mutation.
Create a new customer with firstName, lastName, email, phone, tags, and note.
Get a single customer by ID with full detail including addresses, note, state, and createdAt.
Get customer amountSpent, numberOfOrders, and first/last visible order dates. True first/last order history can require Shopify read_all_orders access beyond the default order window.
List visible orders for a specific customer. Historical orders beyond Shopify's default order window can require read_all_orders access.
List customers with cursor pagination. Returns displayName, email, ordersCount, totalSpent, tags, and state.
Remove one or more tags from a customer using the tagsRemove mutation.
Search customers by email, name, phone, or tag. Uses the Shopify customers(query:) filter syntax.
Update customer fields such as name, email, phone, and note.

change_from_quantity.description: Optional compare-and-swap expected current quantity. Omit to send explicit null and skip the CAS check.

delta.description: Quantity change - positive to add, negative to subtract

inventory_item_id.description: Shopify GID of the inventory item

actions.description: Adjust inventory quantity by a delta (positive to add, negative to subtract) at a specific location. Uses the inventoryAdjustQuantities mutation.
Look up inventory items by SKU string. Uses the inventoryItems query with a SKU filter.

id.description: Shopify GID of the inventory item

actions.description: Get an inventory item by its Shopify GID. Returns SKU, tracked status, and inventory levels per location with quantities.
Get all inventory items at a specific location. Returns items with SKU, available, and incoming quantities.
List inventory levels across all locations. Returns location name and available/committed/on_hand quantities. Supports cursor pagination.

change_from_quantity.description: Optional compare-and-swap expected current quantity. Omit to send explicit null and skip the CAS check.

inventory_item_id.description: Shopify GID of the inventory item

actions.description: Set inventory to an exact quantity at a specific location. Uses the inventorySetQuantities mutation.
Add or update a private note on an order.
Add one or more tags to an order.
Create a draft order with line items, optional customer, shipping address, and note. Returns draft order with calculated totals.
Get a single order by ID with customer, addresses, notes, tags, fulfillments, and the first 50 line items plus pagination metadata.
Get an order by its exact Shopify order name (for example, #1001 or a custom prefixed name). Uses Shopify order search by name.
Get the fulfillment status of an order with tracking numbers, carrier, and tracking URLs for each fulfillment.
Get the event timeline for an order (comments, status changes, fulfillments, refunds).
List visible orders with optional filtering by status, financial status, and fulfillment status. Returns order details including first-page line items, customer summary, and fulfillment tracking.
Mark an order as paid using the orderMarkAsPaid mutation. Shopify also requires the acting staff user to have the mark_orders_as_paid permission.
Search orders by query string (customer name, email, order number, date range). Uses Shopify's order search syntax.
Update an existing note on an order.
Set or replace tags on an order using orderUpdate; supplied tags overwrite the order's tag list.
Create a new collection with title and optional description.
Create a new product with title, description, vendor, product type, status, and tags.
Add a variant to an existing product with price, SKU, and options. Options format: "OptionName:Value" (e.g. "Size:Large,Color:Red").
Get a single collection by its Shopify GID. Returns collection details with its products.
Get a single product by its Shopify GID. Returns product detail with first 10 media and first 100 variants plus pagination metadata.
Get a product by its URL handle (slug). Returns product detail with first 10 media and first 100 variants plus pagination metadata.
Get a single product variant by its Shopify GID. Returns full variant detail including price, SKU, and selected options.
List collections with cursor pagination. Returns collection title, handle, products count, and image.
List variants for a product with cursor pagination. Returns variant details including price, SKU, inventory, and selected options.
List products with optional filtering by status, vendor, and product type. Supports cursor pagination.
Add or remove tags on a product. Provide arrays of tags to add and/or remove.
Search products by keyword query string using Shopify full-text search. Supports cursor pagination.
Update product fields such as title, description, vendor, product type, and status.
Change a product's status to ACTIVE, DRAFT, ARCHIVED, or UNLISTED.
Update variant fields such as price and SKU.

first.description: Number of records in this page.

after.description: Provider cursor from the preceding page.

actions.description: Fetch one inventoryItems page with available quantities, locations, variant and product identity. Returns native edges and pageInfo; the caller selects pagination and any stock thresholds.

first.description: Number of records in this page.

after.description: Provider cursor from the preceding page.

actions.description: Fetch one productVariants page with inventory quantity and product identity. Returns native edges and pageInfo without stock risk classification.

first.description: Number of records in this page.

after.description: Provider cursor from the preceding page.

query.description: Explicit Shopify order search filter, passed as the fixed query variable.

actions.description: Fetch one orders page using an explicit Shopify order search query. Includes each order's first 250 line items with quantity, variant ID and line-item pageInfo. Returns native edges and pageInfo; the caller chooses any date window and pagination.

setup.fallback_reason: Access-token acquisition depends on the Shopify app configuration; use the official authentication documentation.
setup.setup_note: Supply an existing Shopify Admin API access token and the store myshopify.com domain. The token requires the scopes for the selected requests; acquire it outside this library.
